<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="pinkGradient" cx="0%" cy="0%" r="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D33753"/>
      <stop offset="53%" stop-color="#D13660"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C72D65"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F7F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">9:41</text>
  <line x1="313" y1="14" x2="313" y2="19" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="12" x2="318" y2="19" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="10" x2="323" y2="19" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="8" x2="328" y2="19" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="18" x2="352" y2="21" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#222222"/>
  <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#222222"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,54 20,62 28,70" fill="none" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="45" y="68" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Confirm and pay</text>
    <circle cx="353" cy="62" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="57" r="4" fill="#222222"/>
    <ellipse cx="353" cy="67" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#222222"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Listing summary -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="91" width="350" height="116" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="89" width="350" height="116" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <rect x="32" y="101" width="102" height="92" rx="8" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="111" cy="112" r="8" fill="#F6D7DF"/>
    <polygon points="39,183 64,143 79,160 91,148 126,183" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="61,183 82,157 99,172 108,163 130,183" fill="#B9B9B9"/>
    <text x="151" y="117" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Entire rental unit</text>
    <text x="151" y="141" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Sunny modern retreat</text>
    <text x="151" y="163" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">2 beds · Hosted by Maya</text>
    <polygon points="153,185 155,179 161,179 156,175 158,169 153,172 148,169 150,175 145,179 151,179" fill="#222222"/>
    <text x="165" y="183" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">4.99</text>
    <text x="202" y="183" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">337 reviews</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip details -->
  <text x="20" y="243" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Your trip</text>
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="274" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">DATES</text>
    <text x="20" y="296" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#222222">Jun 14 – Jun 19, 2025</text>
    <text x="285" y="296" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="590" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">Edit</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="312" x2="370" y2="312" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <text x="20" y="341" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">GUESTS</text>
    <text x="20" y="363" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#222222">1 guest</text>
    <text x="285" y="363" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="590" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">Edit</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="20" y1="388" x2="370" y2="388" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>

  <!-- Price details -->
  <text x="20" y="425" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Price details</text>
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="459" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222">$440 x 5 nights</text>
    <text x="370" y="459" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">$2,200</text>
    <text x="20" y="490" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222">Cleaning fee</text>
    <text x="370" y="490" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">$200</text>
    <text x="20" y="521" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222">Taxes</text>
    <text x="370" y="521" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">Included</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="541" x2="370" y2="541" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <text x="20" y="574" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Total before taxes</text>
    <text x="370" y="574" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="590" fill="#222222" text-anchor="end">$2,400</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cancellation callout -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="599" width="350" height="76" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="624" r="12" fill="#F6D7DF"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="618" x2="45" y2="625" stroke="#C13515" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="630" r="1.5" fill="#C13515"/>
    <text x="67" y="622" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="590" fill="#222222">Free cancellation</text>
    <text x="67" y="646" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Cancel before Jun 7 for a full refund.</text>
    <text x="67" y="665" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="590" text-decoration="underline" fill="#222222">Learn more</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Reserve action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="695" width="350" height="52" rx="8" fill="url(#pinkGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="728" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="590" fill="#FFFFFF">Reserve</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="770" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">You won't be charged yet</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="789" width="390" height="55" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="789" x2="390" y2="789" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,808 46,801 54,808 54,818 48,818 48,812 44,812 44,818 38,818" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="46" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="125" cy="809" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="814" x2="135" y2="819" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="125" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Wishlists</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="196" y="803" width="15" height="12" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="200,815 198,819 204,815" fill="#5E5E5E"/>
    <text x="204" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="298" cy="806" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="298" cy="816" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="298" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5E5E5E">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
